title: Roboratory machine.yaml
description: A machine: the agent that does one step of a line, and what it may do. See docs/FORMATS.md.

schema_version.description: The version of this format, not of the product.

agent.description: The agent that runs the step. Defaults to claude.

model.description: The model the agent uses; the agent's own default when absent.

goal.description: What the machine is for, used by any line that gives the piece no goal of its own.

attempts.description: How many times the step is tried before the machine catches fire. Defaults to 3.

timeout.description: How long one attempt may work, like 90s, 10m or 2h; a number is seconds. Defaults to 10m.

roles.description: Shared role files, relative to the factory, placed before the machine's own role.md.

dirs.description: Extra folders the agent may use.

tools.description: MCP servers or tools the agent may use, as mcp__server or mcp__server__tool.

allow.description: Commands the machine may run besides the defaults, as prefixes (npm test), or tool names (Edit). Anything else is asked of a person.

deny.description: Commands the machine must never run, added to the factory's, the sector's and the line's.

outward.description: Commands and tools of this machine that act outside it (git push, gh pr create, mcp__slack__post). A normal run ignores this; a rehearsal refuses each one.

read_only.description: No file edits and no git push. The commands in allow still run.

sim.description: How the simulated agent behaves (agent: sim). Free-form.
